description: This file contains C source code implementing cache manipulation routines for a MIPS architecture, specifically for LZMA compressed kernel loading on Atheros AR7XXX/AR9XXX boards. It defines a function to flush CPU caches over a specified address range using inline assembly instructions.

methods.name: void flush_cache(unsigned long start_addr,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Flushes the CPU cache over a specified memory range by performing cache writeback and invalidation.
